enrichment.headline: Approves Coliseum College Prep Academy trip to Under Armour's Project Rampart in Baltimore
enrichment.summary: The Board is asked to approve travel for five students from Coliseum College Prep Academy and nine district staff members to visit Under Armour's Project Rampart in Baltimore, Maryland. The trip runs April 4 through April 8, 2026, and is part of the Oakland Athletic League. The agenda lists no fiscal impact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
